scope: Conditional configuration transport to ISP registers; not ISP pixel arithmetic or camera execution.

matrix_route.finding: Calls MakeColorMatrix; emits descriptor ID 0xe/version 2/size 0x2c and ID 0xf/version 0xc/size 0x34. Upper routing flags are 0x40, 0xb0 or 0x50; CoachModeToStillServerMode converts these to the numeric cache mode index. I43_SetImageProcessing is called conditionally for the first descriptor and for the second descriptor.

IDs 0xe/0xf are type 0 and keep their ID through StillIpcode2PathIpCode. ConvertImgProcStructToPathParamEx removes the upper four-byte mode field by copying payload +0x18 to +0x14. Cache address is 0x815c6f30 + 4*(mode*0x4a + submode*0x25 + id); dirty bits 0x200000/0x100000 respectively.

Reads that same cache formula. Modes 2/5 can fall back to mode 0 when the selected slot is null. Tail-transfers to PathSetImageProcessing 0x801c21e8. Path type 0 calls IpuSetFilter at 0x801c2368; null descriptor returns 0.

Loads path+0x880 and tail-transfers to CImageProcessor::SetFilter 0x80338108. Descriptors are copied into separately allocated RAM; its pointer is stored at processor+0x48+12*id with adjacent dirty state; this stage writes RAM, not MMIO.

Processor constructor installs CTranslatorC12 at +0x254. Its vtable+0xc is CreateFilter 0x8034a604. Low-level filter 10 maps to upper ID 0xe; low-level filter 13 maps to upper ID 0xf. UpdateFilterInterface consumes processor descriptor slots and invokes filter vtable+0x20.

Creates CFilterFactory wrapper whose child is CFilterFactoryC12p; this delegates IDs other than 0x20 to C12m. C12m cases 10/13 construct CCmFilter/CFc1Filter. Their vtable+0x20 methods accept IDs 0xe/0xf, respectively.

When the configuration is non-null and task+0x1f8 is zero, iterates the configuration filters; compares their UID with the driver cached UID and invokes vtable+8 when different. CCm/CFc1 writers additionally require object byte +0x29 nonzero. CBC configuration emission is an alternate path; direct stores are not assumed for every capture.

registers.name: CM coefficients
registers.source: CCmFilter +0x88..+0xa8 (u32 fields loaded from signed descriptor halfwords)
registers.note: Descriptor versions 2/12 sign-extend nine s16 values from +0x14..+0x24. No pixel multiply occurs in the writer.

registers.name: CM companion fields
registers.note: Field purpose beyond these observed mappings is not assigned from undocumented registers.

registers.name: FC1 coefficients
registers.note: Upper descriptor ID 0xf maps to low-level filter 13 (FC1), not FC2. Companion +0x42/+0x44/+0x48 map to 0xb60000e4/00e8/00fc.

registers.name: FC2 alternative
registers.source: CFc2Filter signed halfwords +0x30..+0x40 in source index order
registers.note: Low-level filter 20 is a separate FIPLIB path. Do not attach upper ID 0xf directly to this register bank.

registers.name: Statistics gamma LUT
registers.source: index/reset 0, 77 successive source u32 values to one fixed data port, final 0
registers.note: 77 data writes, not 77 consecutive MMIO addresses; CguUnitSetEnabled(0xe,1/0) surrounds the loop.

registers.name: DCI statistics gamma LUT
registers.source: reset 0 then count source u32 values to fixed data port
registers.note: Count zero still resets the index and gates the clock, but makes no data-port writes.

registers.name: Statistics busy bits
registers.note: Polling precedes gamma port programming. Hardware timing is not replayed.

white_balance.finding: Four unsigned input halfwords shift right by 2 into sensor filter ID3; channel index order 0,1,3,2. It caches the original halfwords, then shifts by 4 into a statistics descriptor ID0x40. The link from SetDevelopPreGain to this entry and final sensor gain MMIO is not established here.

limitations: FIPLIB may update the same low-level filter after the upper descriptor when force/dirty flags and pass-wrapper pointer permit it. The final per-capture coefficient values and all pass selection conditions remain unproven.
A common configuration route does not establish a single chronological WB/matrix/gamma/clip pixel pipeline.
Gamma registers here belong to named statistics paths; they are not evidence that the final JPEG pixels use the same LUT.
CBC alternate submission, real DMA completion, internal accumulator widths, clipping order, demosaic and physical final pixel values are not verified.
Ghidra may inline tail transfers past a selected candidate; call metadata uses original MIPS instructions and sidecar bounds.

evidence.role: Upper dispatch call and path/cache consumer tail transfers

decompilation.tool: Ghidra 12.1 / JDK 21; no auto-analysis, explicit symbol-derived candidates
